Mission Local reported that, after a two-and-a-half-year process, the State Bar placed DA Brooke Jenkins in a diversionary program over ethics complaints. The story said the complaints were “best resolved” by requiring her participation, and that the State Bar acted on the complaint involving her access to and sharing of a confidential rap sheet; it dismissed the other ethics complaints.
